gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-telex: Telex has curvy, loose-limbed letters that feel unclamped, clean enough to stay out of the way. But Shantell Sans, drawn with one fixed nib width, gives headings some bounce while Telex keeps long paragraphs flowing smoothly.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-tenor-sans: Cable-thick strokes up top, soft pencil shading below. Shantell Sans is best at wide-mouthed, expressive headings, while Tenor Sans does its finest work in light, gently varied text with c tips held well apart.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-titillium-web: Approachable describes both, though Shantell Sans draws strokes that never swell or thin, its mouths wide as a tin can's lid. Shantell Sans brings the personality; Titillium Web keeps its stroke ends far apart.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-tomorrow: Hand-drawn charm up top: Shantell Sans never shifts weight between its downstrokes and its connecting curves. Tomorrow gives that energy somewhere to land, bowls open like cupped palms.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-tuffy: Shantell Sans opens its mouths wide as a tin can's cut lid, every stroke drawn with one fixed nib. Tuffy then joins in, sketched with a pencil that never presses harder, its s widely parted.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-urbanist: Contemporary and easygoing, Urbanist writes with a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut beneath Shantell Sans headings. Long paragraphs glide along like the single-width trail of a rolling-ball pen.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-varela: Shantell Sans draws every stroke with one fixed nib width. Varela meets it with a crossbar and stem sharing one width, plus c shapes that look like a wide mouth, so both keep a friendly openness.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-varela-round: Loose and hand-drawn, Shantell Sans keeps one fixed nib width throughout. Varela Round frames its counters with same-width strokes and wide-mouthed rounds, so the two sit comfortably on one page.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text keeps its terminals open and inviting. Shantell Sans puts rounds and stems in one weight for a hand-drawn heading, so text beneath it settles into a smooth, contemporary rhythm.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Hand-drawn rope up top, sharpened pencil below. Shantell Sans keeps every stem, bowl and tail uniform with a rope-like consistency, while ZCOOL XiaoWei tapers modestly, like a sharpened carpenter's pencil.
